subject: physics

chapters.title: Electric Charges and Fields
chapters.summary: Static charge is described by Coulomb's law and by the field it sets up. Superposition, field lines, the electric dipole and continuous charge distributions then lead to Gauss's law, which gives the field of a long wire, an infinite sheet and a spherical shell.
sections: Electric dipole and torque on it
objectives: State Coulomb's law and apply the superposition principle to a system of point charges.
Relate electric field, electric flux and enclosed charge through Gauss's law.
Find the field of a long straight wire, an infinite plane sheet and a thin spherical shell.
